summary: Engineering preview: native Instrument Teal HOME/banks and Groove/Loop/Mix/Click now lead into EDIT for a protected sixteen-slot semantic draft. Numbered chord/timing/voicing/bass/phrase controls, explicit remove confirmation and one-step undo feed the same accompaniment clock; quarter slots, gates/ties and bar-bound groove edits preserve phase. Active and pending plans, real cursor and planned focus stay distinct. Safe stopped-only checkpoints report RAM Pending, verified Checkpoint or Recovered, with checked backup object 75. Native editor count-in/capture stays visible with real REC status and read-only draft controls. Factory originals, live Harmony/HOLD and the current manual-take/latest-three policy remain protected. Songs now has a first native preview: SAVE from HOME, accompaniment or editor opens a shared list with six saved semantic idea slots plus the existing three recording slots. SEL on Save current stages a complete musical snapshot; stopped/quiet persistence reports Pending until its checked A/B commit succeeds. Saved ideas support Load, Rename, Duplicate and Cancel-default Delete; existing recordings load their fixed-note workspace or can be deleted while quiet. Unsaved working drafts block replacement, and sound-only SAVE remains on sound pages. Direct arranged capture, expanded recording capacity, recording rename/duplicate, counted bulk clear, chord-library/audition, learning/suggestions, remaining page/motion migration and physical verification are pending. See docs/SONGS-LIBRARY.md for this preview's exact controls and limits.
